chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamadani (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: 'Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from 'Abd al-Salam ibn Salih al-Harawi. He said: I said to 'Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him):

O son of the Messenger of Allah! What do you say regarding the hadith that the scholars of hadith narrate: 'Verily, the believers will visit their Lord from their homes in Paradise?' He (peace be upon him) said: O Abu al-Salt! Verily, Allah — Blessed and Exalted — has favoured His Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) over all of His creation, from the prophets to the angels. He made his obedience His own obedience, his following His own following, and visiting him in this world and the Hereafter as visiting Him.

So He — Mighty and Majestic — said: 'He who obeys the Messenger has obeyed Allah' [4:80], and He said: 'Verily, those who pledge allegiance to you are only pledging allegiance to Allah — the hand of Allah is over their hands' [48:10]. And the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever visits me in my life or after my death has visited Allah, the Majestic.' And the rank of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in Paradise is the highest of ranks, so whoever visits him at his rank in Paradise from his home has visited Allah — Blessed and Exalted.

He said: So I said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! Then what is the meaning of the report they narrate: 'The reward of saying There is no god but Allah is looking at the Face of Allah?' He (peace be upon him) said: O Abu al-Salt! Whoever describes Allah with a face like faces has committed disbelief. Rather, the Face of Allah is His prophets, His messengers, and His Proofs (may Allah's blessings be upon them) — they are those through whom one turns towards Allah, His religion, and knowledge of Him. And Allah — Mighty and Majestic — said: 'All that is upon it shall perish, while the Face of your Lord shall remain' [55:26-27], and He — Mighty and Majestic — said: 'Everything is perishing except His Face' [28:88]. So looking at the prophets of Allah, His messengers, and His Proofs (peace be upon them) in their ranks is a great reward for the believers on the Day of Resurrection.

And the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever harbours hatred for my Ahl al-Bayt and my progeny will not see me, nor will I see him on the Day of Resurrection.' And he (peace be upon him) said: 'Verily among you is one who will not see me after he parts from me.' O Abu al-Salt! Verily, Allah — Blessed and Exalted — is not described with place, nor is He comprehended by sight or imaginations. He said: So I said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! Inform me about Paradise and the Fire — are they both created today? He said: Yes, and verily the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered Paradise and saw the Fire when he was taken up to the heavens.

He said: So I said to him: But there are people who say they are predestined but not yet created. He (peace be upon him) said: Those people are not of us, nor are we of them. Whoever denies the creation of Paradise and the Fire has belied the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and belied us. They have no part in our wilaya whatsoever, and will abide forever in the Fire of Hell. Allah — Mighty and Majestic — said: 'This is the Hell that the criminals deny — they circle between it and scalding water' [55:43-44].

And the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When I was taken up to the heavens, Gabriel (peace be upon him) took me by the hand and brought me into Paradise. He gave me from its fresh dates and I ate it. That transformed into a sperm-drop in my loins. When I descended to the Earth, I was intimate with Khadija, and she became pregnant with Fatima. Fatima is a heavenly maiden in human form, so whenever I long for the fragrance of Paradise, I smell the fragrance of my daughter Fatima.'

key_terms.الولاية: Wilaya — spiritual authority and guardianship of the Imams; to be outside wilaya is to be spiritually lost
key_terms.حجج: Proofs/Divine Proofs — the Imams as God's authoritative representatives on earth
key_terms.حوراء إنسية: Human houri — Fatima described as a heavenly maiden (houri) in human form, connecting her to Paradise
key_terms.زيارة: Visitation/visiting — theologically reinterpreted as visiting the Prophet equals visiting Allah
key_terms.وجه الله: Face of Allah — interpreted as the prophets, messengers, and Imams (Proofs) of God, not a literal face

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida say about visiting Allah in Paradise and the meaning of 'the Face of Allah'?
ai.summary: In this lengthy theological exchange, Abu al-Salt al-Harawi questions Imam al-Rida (AS) about two controversial hadith reports circulating among the traditionalists of the time (early 3rd century AH): one claiming believers will 'visit their Lord' from Paradise, and another claiming the reward of the shahada is 'looking at the Face of Allah.' The Imam rejects the anthropomorphic interpretations and offers instead a theological explanation rooted in divine transcendence — visiting Allah means visiting the Prophet, and the 'Face of Allah' refers to His Proofs (prophets and Imams) through whom God is known. He then affirms the pre-eternal creation of Paradise and the Fire, condemning those who deny it as outside the pale of Shia Islam. The hadith concludes with a remarkable cosmological narration about the Prophet's night journey and Fatima's celestial origin.
